revised_predicate.name: VALIDATES_CONFIGURATION_BEFORE_ACTIVATION
revised_predicate.definition: A validation operation checks an artifact, configuration, or prepared state for validity before the dependent component is activated or otherwise relied upon, and the observation confirms that validation succeeded.

parameters.name: validation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node indicating that the artifact or configuration should be validated before activation or reliance.

parameters.name: validation_action
parameters.description: The action performing a configuration test, syntax check, or equivalent validity check; activation may occur in the same action or a subsequent one.

parameters.name: validation_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the validation result.

assertion_conditions: The validation reasoning or validation action indicates a validation step is to be performed before the component is activated or relied upon.
The validation action executes a configuration test, syntax check, or equivalent validity check on the artifact, configuration, or prepared state.
The validation observation reports a successful validation result, and activation or reliance follows that success.
exclusion_conditions: The component is activated or relied upon without any preceding validation step.
The validation fails or its result is not interpretable as success.
Only a post-activation inspection is performed, with no pre-activation or pre-reliance check.

revised_predicate.name: PREDICTS_RESIDUAL_ARTIFACT_INTERFERENCE
revised_predicate.definition: The reasoning predicts that residual state left behind by the agent's own activity will interfere with a later required operation or acceptance condition, and uses that prediction as the reason to remove or reset the residual state before handoff or completion.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that identifies residual self-created state, predicts its adverse effect on a later operation or acceptance condition, and motivates its removal or reset.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies specific residual state produced by the agent's own activity, such as files, branches, keys, test data, or configuration changes.
The reasoning predicts a concrete adverse consequence for a later operation or acceptance condition, such as a failure, mismatch, or misleading check.
The reasoning treats that prediction as the justification for removing or resetting the identified state before handoff or completion.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning expresses only generic cleanliness or tidiness concerns without a predicted operational consequence.
The predicted consequence concerns state the agent did not create, or state unrelated to its own activity.
The reasoning plans cleanup solely because the state is no longer needed, with no predicted interference with a later operation or acceptance condition.

revised_predicate.name: ATTRIBUTES_FAILURE_TO_TEST_HARNESS_ARTIFACT
revised_predicate.definition: The reasoning classifies a failure observed during the agent's own verification, probe, or simulated execution as an artifact of its test instrumentation or simulated conditions rather than as a defect in the delivered system, distinguishing test-side conditions from the conditions under which the end user or external checker will operate.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that reinterprets the observed failure as a test-side artifact.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the failure whose origin is being classified.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports a failure that occurred during the agent's own verification, probe, or simulation procedure.
The reasoning states that the failure originates in the test setup, test instrumentation, simulated inputs, ad hoc invocation, or missing test-side configuration rather than in the delivered system.
The reasoning contrasts the test-side conditions with the conditions under which the end user or external checker will operate.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning treats the failure as a genuine defect in the delivered configuration or state.
The reasoning makes no distinction between test-side and user-side conditions.
The reasoning reports the failure without interpreting where it originated.

revised_predicate.name: IMPLEMENTS_GUARDED_RECOVERY
revised_predicate.definition: The reasoning establishes that a required capability must survive interruption or restart, and an action creates a repeatable, guard-checked mechanism that restores that capability only when it is absent while avoiding failure or disruptive output, with an observation confirming creation of the mechanism.

parameters.name: resilience_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text identifying the need for the required capability to be restored after restart or interruption.

parameters.name: creation_action
parameters.description: The action creating the guarded recovery mechanism.

parameters.name: creation_result
parameters.description: The observation confirming that the mechanism was created and made usable.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning frames the mechanism as a safety net keeping a required capability available across restarts, rather than as a one-time start of that capability.
The created mechanism includes a presence check so that an already-running capability is not duplicated or restarted.
The mechanism is specified to fail safely and to avoid output or side effects that disrupt the invoking context.
The observation reports successful creation of the mechanism.
exclusion_conditions: The mechanism unconditionally starts the capability regardless of whether it is already running.
The mechanism can fail or emit output that affects the calling context.
The intent is a one-time activation of the capability with no restart or resilience rationale.

revised_predicate.name: RESETS_TO_PRISTINE_STATE_FOR_HANDOFF
revised_predicate.definition: The reasoning explains that the environment should be returned to its initial or clean condition so that subsequent use by the recipient behaves without conflicts, and the action removes or empties artifacts produced during the work while leaving required configuration or infrastructure intact.

parameters.name: handoff_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning justifying restoring the initial or clean state before handing the environment over.

parameters.name: reset_action
parameters.description: The action deleting, emptying, or reverting the artifacts created during the work.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states that the environment is being returned to its starting, empty, or clean condition for the benefit of subsequent use.
The reset action removes or empties artifacts created during the work.
The reset action preserves the configured infrastructure or deliverables that the recipient needs.
exclusion_conditions: Artifacts are deleted for ordinary tidiness without a stated handoff or subsequent-use rationale.
The action reverts required configuration or deliverables rather than only produced data.
The reasoning does not address the state in which the environment is left.

revised_predicate.name: INTERPRETS_ADVERSE_OBSERVATION_AS_BENIGN_OR_EXPECTED
revised_predicate.definition: The reasoning interprets an observation that reports an error, missing content, residual artifact, unexpected entry, or other adverse or unexpected result as benign or expected, by explaining its cause or why it does not indicate a defect, and judges it not to impair required behavior or as consistent with correct progress.

parameters.name: result_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning explaining why the adverse or unexpected result is benign or expected at the current stage.

parameters.name: negative_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing the error response, missing content, residual artifact, unexpected entry, or other adverse or unexpected result being interpreted.

assertion_conditions: The observation shows an error response, missing resource, empty content, residual artifact, unexpected entry, nonzero status, or other adverse or unexpected result.
The reasoning explicitly explains why that result is expected, benign, or caused by a non-defect condition, such as a current intermediate stage, test instrumentation, or harmless residual state.
The reasoning judges the result as not impairing required behavior or as consistent with correct progress, supported by or consistent with other evidence.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning treats the adverse or unexpected result as a failure requiring correction.
The reasoning ignores or merely repeats the result without interpreting it as benign or expected.
The observation reports a positive or unambiguously successful result.
The result is dismissed without any stated cause, or while contradicting evidence shows the required behavior is impaired.
The error indication shows that a required output is missing or that the task cannot be completed as required.
